_comment: Cards for tests/unit/test_starting_life_total.py. `t_valkyrie_anthem` is Righteous Valkyrie's third line on its own: a static anthem switched by `life >= starting_life + 7`, on an enchantment so the test's creature is not also the thing being buffed by its own printed body.

cards.name: Test Valkyrie Anthem
cards.oracle_text: As long as you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total, creatures you control get +2/+2.

abilities.text: As long as you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total, creatures you control get +2/+2.
